descriptionInUI: Optional in-mission scripted air coordination for both sides, without an LLM, while an airborne, operating AWACS or a powered command centre survives. Redirects available BARCAP/TARCAP patrols and returning fighter-capable flights against detected aircraft and interceptable cruise/anti-ship missiles. Protects vulnerable flights and holds attacks behind known SAM threats while DEAD is working. Temporary orders retain the original mission. Excludes Player/Client groups and active escort/AFAC navigation. F10 pause controls allow manual tasking. No emergency scrambles or ground orders. Off by default.

Show command-source changes, decisions and rejection reasons to the owning coalition (at most four debug messages per minute). Also write detailed IMAC|DEBUG diagnostics to dcs.log, including active orders, fuel and remaining lease time. Independent of normal order reports; disabled sides show no debug messages.
